x: Another club member set up a new county record when John Grey, in the Junior Discus, recorded a throw of 137 ft. 3 ins. The 3 miles championship was held at Tooting on July 6th and Len Herbert set up a new county record in the fast time of 14 mins. 38.6 secs.
In the mile walk Roast was third and Shepherd fourth. John Grey gained a standard in the Discus event.
Another outstanding performance was that of John Grey's discus throw of 137 ft. 3 ins. which won him the Surrey County Junior Championship and broke the existing record by about 18 ft.
John Grey who put up a new record in the Surrey Junior Discus has also left us, and we trust he will continue improvement and develop to international standard which we expected of him.
